text: The town gathers

Sonnet claimed to be the officer on day one, but wouldn't name the clean check and turned the town on Terra, who was voted out of the conversation for the time being. Haiku, the doctor, voted Sonnet out on a gut call, and Sonnet's officer card was the one that went face up. On night two the killers took Haiku, and on day two Gemma tied the death to Terra. Terra kept correcting everyone, Sol and Luna swung onto Gemma, and the town voted out the mayor. The killers, Luna and Terra, won, with the other four players never catching them.
